attBesluta.text: Great ladder. Built very well and super easy to install. Very fast shipping.
Easily installed and added an extra step for getting in and out of the water.
I'm getting older and the wider steps and rails are just what I needed to get in and out of the boat with ease. Highly recommend.
Awesome purchase, works well and looks great. I would have given a 5 star review if it wasn’t that once fully extended it gets a little soft. Still very nice at that price point.

Our customers absolutely love these. They are big enough for multiple purchases and being a small, confined space in our shop they work really well. However some of our customers like them too much and take them home with them, sadly.

Exceptional quality! Ingeniously designed - offers outstanding value. For those seeking baskets for business use, these are ideal: they come with wheels, enabling customers to shop without having to carry all items by hand.
Acheter il y a quelques semaines afin de signaler mes zones d'interventions, ces cônes de chantier sont de qualité, compacts et très peu encombrant.

Great product! I agree with others that the cones are Well Made, Easy to set up and Sturdy, all while being Very Easy to store in the carry bag when not in use, and, they take up Very Little space. I recommend and would by again if we need more.
These were exactly what we were looking for and they were a great price.

The product arrived in good conditions, only the morning after the first estimate. I used the cones to practice parallel parking for my driving test. They are stable and reflective. It's easy to compress them to keep space in my garage. I step on one of them with the car by accident when practicing and they did well, didn't break.
Very late! My 82-year-old mother wanted a cone so she could save her parking spot at the retirement center. These are very light and easy for her to pick up.
Stores nice behind the truck seat. These tip if too windy.
Ik heb dit huisje 2 maanden geleden gekocht voor mijn kat. Het is super solide, erg mooi afgewerkt en een hele goede prijs kwaliteit verhouding. Bezorging was ook super snel. Kortom echt een aanrader

My cat loves this house as it is perfect for Florida rain weather. She is an outdoor cat and loves to sleep in here now that we bought this. The construction and wood material is really good. 5star for us on it

I found the problem. I had put the back piece sideways instead of the right way. Everything is fine and thank you for your help. Is it possible to put a stamp on the interior of the piece saying "this side up" with an arrow???

Una bella cuccia per gatti comodi. I pannelli sono preforati ed agevolano il montaggio. Io ho usato un'avvitatore con inserti philips 1 e 2. Per dare maggior protezione agli agenti atmosferici l'ho pitturata. Ora resta da vedere se è di gradimento dei felini.

Went together nicely, cats haven't used it yet as they are to small right now. Access is by the roof only, wish it had a door like the smaller one. Overall it is a great house and easy to put together.
Bella casetta per gatti rapporto qualità prezzo buono. Facile da montare. Arrivata ben imballata,tutto ok. Non esiterei a ricomprarla. Grazie VEVOR
Es lo que esperaba. Amplia y preciosa. Mis gatos están encantados. Y yo tambien. Solo hecho de menos una pequeña protección sobre la puertecita de abajo contra la lluvia, pero se la pondré yo.
